AccessTokenAuth.description: JWT access token. It expires after 15 minutes.

RefreshTokenAuth.description: Rotating JWT refresh token. Use it only for refresh or logout.

info.summary: Authentication, Sports, and Teams management API.
info.title: Sports App API

post.description: Validates credentials and returns a 15-minute access token plus a rotating refresh token.

delete.description: Accepts either token type and revokes its persistent session.

post.description: Requires the current refresh token. It is invalidated and replaced with a new access/refresh pair; reuse revokes the whole session.
Creates a public account with the referee role.

get.description: Returns every sport ordered by identifier.

post.description: Creates a uniquely normalized Sport. max_players is the Team pool capacity and max_players_in_game is the simultaneous lineup limit.

delete.description: Deletes one Sport only when no enabled or disabled Team references it.

put.description: Changes only the Sport name; both capacity fields are immutable.

get.description: Returns a filtered and paginated Team catalogue. Enabled Teams are returned by default and each page contains at most 25 records.

post.description: Creates an enabled Team. Its identity is unique by normalized name, Sport, and gender category.

get.description: Returns one enabled or disabled Team by identifier.

put.description: Changes only the name of an enabled Team. Sport and gender are immutable.

patch.description: Disables a Team without deleting it. Repeated requests are idempotent.
Enables a Team again. Repeated requests are idempotent.
